title: Escape
text: “What do you mean?”
My Father asked me that. So I, Motoyasu, will answer his question honestly.
“It seems there was a time limit on my loop—once the time that had passed since I died in the first world elapsed, the loop kicked in.”
“Is that so?”
“Wait a minute. Then what’s our situation right now?”
Ren and Itsuki came over to ask. I was just about to explain that. This tendency to get worked up over such minor details really feels like a loop where I’ve recruited Ren and Itsuki as allies.
“I don’t fully understand that part yet, but the Spear Hero has started looping again, and there are times when he returns to the looped world that was supposed to have disappeared.”
“So, are you saying that Motoyasu-san has returned to our current loop…?”
“It’s a relief you’re so quick to catch on. It seems the Minute Hand of the Dragon Hourglass on the Spear Hero is now set to ‘True.’”
“I-I see… So, were you able to hop on the loop like Gaelion-chan said you would?”
“I did! Gaelion hopped on all sorts of loops and even met the ‘Original Ofumi’ and the ‘Wild Naofumi’ that the Spear Hero mentioned.”
“I see. How was it?”
“The ‘Wild Naofumi’ was a tsundere and got along well with Rafu.”
“Oh my—”
Big Sister’s older sister smiled as she listened to Big Sister’s story. She’s smiling because she knows that what could have happened is, in fact, true.
“Being called a tsundere is kind of… well…”
Father looks a bit embarrassed. However, perhaps sensing how long a journey we’ve been on through these loops, he seems very kind.
“So, Gaelion seemed to be targeting Naofumi’s virginity even while looping—did she achieve her ambition?”
“Itsuki… you’re taking an interest in strange things again…”
“Hehe… Gaelion has grown after experiencing a loop where we fell in love with each other.”
“Ah, I see.”
“That’s a pretty casual response for someone who asked the question themselves…”
“So, how long do you plan to stay in this world?”
“I don’t know about that yet. It’s still part of my investigation.”
Since Ren and Itsuki are so engrossed in talking with their Rival, I’ll go talk with my Father.
“They seem to be having a lively conversation over there, so I’ll stay here and chat with you about various things, Father.”
“Yeah, got it.”
Standing a little way away from the group of rivals, I lock eyes with my father. He looks just like he did when we headed for Faubrey.
“Um, should I say ‘welcome back,’ Motoyasu-kun?”
“I suppose so. I’m back.”
“As far as I’m concerned, it seems we can’t just pretend this never happened, so I’m glad.”
“Father, there are a few things I’ve come to understand from the loops so far.”
“Huh… What did you find out?”
I really should explain this properly to my Father.
“Well… the biggest discovery is that Sakura-chan is actually Filo-tan.”
“Ah, so that’s how it is? When I compared all the clues, I had a feeling that might be the case.”
“Hmm?”
Sakura-chan is standing nearby, tilting her head. This is the exchange we always have when Sakura-chan is around during the loop.
“Sakura-chan is Sakura-chan. So you don’t need to overthink it.”

In this world so far, my feelings for Filo-tan have grown even stronger. Even if I don’t get to meet Filo-tan in this world, it’s all right. After all, even if we were originally the same person, Sakura-chan is still Sakura-chan.
“Hmm?”
“You’re not saying anything about turning Sakura-chan into Filo-chan, are you?”
“When I confronted my Rival, I asked if we could loop together with Filo-tan, but he said it was impossible and wouldn’t tell me where to go.”
“Well… I guess that just means Gaelion-chan is special. And Motoyasu-kun, too.”
My father is giving a wry smile.
“So, did you find any useful information?”
“In this new loop, even if Ren or Itsuki die, the loop doesn’t restart! So the restrictions have been eased!”
“‘What!?’”

When I turned around at the sound of their voices, Ren and Itsuki—who were supposed to be talking to our Rival—were approaching us, their faces filled with shock. Hmm? Weren’t they supposed to be busy talking to our Rival?
“Why on earth are you telling Naofumi-san that kind of thing from a distance away from us?!”
“That’s right, that’s right!”
“There’s no particular reason. They just seemed so engrossed in talking to our Rival that I decided to report it to my Father first.”
For some reason, Ren and Itsuki look really tense as they circle around to my Father’s side, trying to keep themselves out of my line of fire.
“You’re not telling me you’ve been killing us in every loop so far just because it was a hassle, are you?!”
“Even the Spear Hero wouldn’t go that far.”
“I kind of get where you’re coming from, but you’re being way too suspicious.”

“It wouldn’t be surprising if Motoyasu did it, though!　Especially since I was summoned just because I’m annoying or something, and right after that, he’d probably say something like ‘Meteor Thrust!’ and blast me away, wouldn’t he?!”
That’s Ren, isn’t it? Itsuki is Brionac. I thought to myself, “Haven’t you already done that a few times before meeting this Itsuki?” but… should I say it?
“Ah… This guy’s already been taking us out to vent his frustration before we even entered this loop. He’s doing it knowing full well we’ll loop back.”
“Haven’t they been doing that even before talking to us?!”
“That’s right, that’s right!”
Ren and Itsuki’s energy levels are way too high. Come to think of it, Ren and Itsuki are the liveliest pair in this loop cluster.
“Wait, since they’ve come back, does that mean they’ll be coming back for the rest of the loop too?”

“That’s right. Ren and Itsuki don’t kill anyone unless they absolutely have to. There have just been times when they died on their own because we left them alone. They were taken down by a nobody like Takt—how embarrassing.”
That reminds me of the loop where both of them were killed by Takt.
“By that guy…”
“He’s already been taken care of. It’ll be shooting at a corpse, but I want to avenge the frustration we felt in that loop.”
“You can’t do it, so just give it up. There’s no point in shooting at a corpse.”
Ren will talk some sense into Itsuki. Don’t be so naive… That’s not going to happen, is it? Takt and anyone involved with him will meet a gruesome end.
“As far as Gaelion can tell, they haven’t gone out of their way to kill the Sword Heroes or Bow Heroes out of spite, so you can rest easy.”
“That’s right. Even without doing something like that, Ren and Itsuki know how to talk things out.”
“That’s good to hear. I mean… how did you manage to deal with us stubborn fools…?”
“Yeah. I hate to say it, but you wouldn’t know unless you failed, right? We’re so convinced we’re right… How did you handle us when even beating us senseless head-on wouldn’t work?”
“Both Ren and Itsuki are so self-deprecating…”
My father looks at Ren and Itsuki with exasperation as he says this.
“Oh my, what a fun exchange.”
“Is this really fun?”
Hehehe… It’s a major discovery. Basically, now that I’ve figured out how to easily win Ren and Itsuki over, my troubles are solved.
“Well, all you have to do is introduce Fleon-chan and Black Thunder… Kuro-chan to Ren and Itsuki, respectively.”
“Who’s that?”
“I’ve never heard of them. I suspect they’re Filolials.”
“They’re special Filolials-sama who get along perfectly with Ren and Itsuki, you see.”
“So you finally found our Filolials?”
“I had a feeling we might want some.”
“I wonder if Ren and Itsuki believed us when we said, ‘Thanks for getting along so well, Motoyasu-kun’?”
Well, that’s about the gist of it. That’s how things are with the Dark Holy Hero and the V3 duo, Ren and Itsuki.
“Naofumi-san, aren’t you being a little too lenient? We’re talking about us here, you know?”
“Why are you being so self-deprecating…”
“After hearing everything so far, do you really think we’d just obediently do as we’re told just because we got along with a Filolial? No way.”
“You just stated that as fact.”
“Well… there’s generally no mistake in what the Spear Hero says.”
Our Rival is saying something with a look of exasperation on his face.
“That reaction means there’s something going on, right? What’s the catch?”
“Well, that’s—”
With that, my Rival and I each explained the situation regarding Ren and Itsuki, who had met Fleon-chan and Black Thunder. I intend to make them as happy as Ren and Itsuki were in that world.
“Isn’t that just brainwashing us and manipulating us however you please?!”
“However you please”? That’s quite an insult. You two started listening to what we had to say while acting entirely of your own free will! I’ve never once ordered you to do anything.
“What do you mean, ‘a way to talk’? You turned us into puppets, didn’t you!”
“Anyway, in this loop, I’m going to go pick up Fleon-chan and Black Thunder again! Yuki-chan, I’d like you to come with me to meet the Immortal.”
“I don’t really understand what’s going on, but all right!”
I beckon Yuki-chan, who’s been listening to our conversation from a short distance away. Standing next to her is Sakura-chan… Ah, that’s right—Filo-tan isn’t here in this loop. What a pity.
“What do you mean, ‘that’s why’!”
There’s no time to waste! The portal… seems to still be slightly affected by the waves, so it’s unusable. Oh well.
“Yuki-chan, hold on tight so you don’t fall off my back, okay?”
“Yes, sir! It’s Motoyasu-sama’s back!”
With Yuki-chan on my back, I’m switching modes!
“Drive Mode!”
“W-wait, turning the spear into wheels… what on earth is that!?”
“W-what is this…!?”
Yuki-chan lets out a cry of surprise. Since the grown-up Yuki-chan found it hilarious, I’m brimming with confidence.
“Wheeeeeee!”
Kicking up a cloud of dust, I race toward the portal’s usable range. While I’m at it, I’ll gather the monster meat lying around for food.
“Human-bike form!?”
“S-someone, stop Motoyasu! Hundred Sword X! Meteor Sword X!”
“That’s right! He’s planning to brainwash and control us in this loop too! Arrow Rain X! Eagle Piercing Shot X!”

Whoa! For some reason, Ren and Itsuki are firing Skills at me and chasing after me! As you’d expect in a world where enhancements are top-notch, their speed and power are on a whole different level. But there’s no way I’m going to get taken out here! I’ll use Float Trans to deflect the incoming attacks while speeding away until I’m completely out of range! It’s a real whizz-whizz!
“What kind of riding is that?! It looks like nothing more than an internet meme!”
“So even in Itsuki’s world, there’s all sorts of stuff going on… That’s all it looks like to me, too. I wonder where Motoyasu-kun is heading off to.”
“He’s been doing this a lot since the loop started over again. It’s practically a familiar sight now.”
“It’s… w… wonderful…”
Yuki-chan complimented my driving style. Though, she seems a bit less energetic than the adult-looking Yuki-chan I saw when I reunited with Fleon-chan.
“Someone! Even a Filolial will do! Take us with you and chase after Motoyasu!”
“We won’t lose! Hahaha! Fleon-chan and Black Thunder are waiting for us!”

And just like that, Renzou, Itsuki, and my Father grew smaller. Once I reached the range where a portal could be created, I used it to travel down to the Hermit’s place. So, I showed Yuki-chan to the Immortal to negotiate and had him hand over Fleon-chan, then I scouted Black Thunder as well, raised them both properly, and we headed back to my Father and the others. The Immortal had already heard about Melromarc’s rampage during this loop, so he gladly accepted me. After all, an Immortal is an Immortal. Fleon-chan and Black Thunder grew up freely and happily.
“We’re home! Oh? Where are Ren and Itsuki?”
I returned to base and immediately tried to introduce Fleon-chan and Black Thunder to Ren and Itsuki, but the two of them were nowhere to be found.
“They both ran away,”

Father said with an exasperated look on his face, alongside Big Sister’s older sister. About a week later, Ren and Itsuki returned. For some reason, Itsuki was wearing headphones. Ren was wearing thick, stylish glasses and had switched to a more subdued set of armor.
